thread:
Ari (Marketing): Quick idea — run a 45m webinar focused on practical inference for early-stage companies. Working title: "MicroLabs: cost-efficient inference pipelines". Short, tactical, demo-heavy. Looking for ✅ topic, speakers, and rehearsal plan by EOW.
Sam (Content): love it. Two suggested angles: 1) engineering playbook (batching, KV caching, quantization) 2) product story (latency tradeoffs + cost). We can split into 30m talk + 10m panel + 5m Q&A.
Priya (Product): can we surface a simple checklist for attendees to self-eval cost/latency? that makes the hook more actionable.
Jules (Growth): audience ask — mid-market platform engineers + startup founders. Need clear CTA: register for checklist + benchmark report. We'll use gated content to route MQLs.
Diego (Ops): Logistics: green room 30m prior. Need a recording fallback in case live demo dies. Also who owns the demo infra? Evan?
Evan (Runtime): I can own demo infra. We'll prepare two model endpoints (fast quantized + high-quality FP16) and a recorded fallback. Also will add prefix caching demo.
Maya (Benchmarks): I can present a 6-slide benchmark summary — 3 charts: throughput vs batch, cost per 1k tokens, tail latency distribution. Need raw numbers by Tue.
Ari (Marketing): Good. Action items: Sam — draft two abstracts (tech / product). Maya/Evan — bench + demo assets. Jules — lead routing + copy. Priya/Diego — run-of-show and greenroom ops. Comments? :thumbsup:
Sam (Content): I'll post two abstract options by tomorrow noon. Short versions for landing page + long for speaker notes.
Jules (Growth): Lead routing: registration form must include company size, infra (hosted/dedicated/private), and priority (latency/cost/security). Rules: if company size > 500 => route to enterprise SDRs; otherwise route to growth SDRs. Also tag registrants who choose "private" as high-touch.
Priya (Product): For the checklist CTA: 7 bullet self-eval. I'll draft and share on Wed.
Diego (Ops): Proposed rehearsal slots:
  - Tech check (audio/video + demo smoke): Wed 09:00 PT (30m)
  - Full run-through (slides + demo + panel): Thu 10:00 PT (45m)
  - Backup quickcheck: day-of 30m before live
greenroom-bot: Rehearsal slots created and invites sent to listed participants. Use link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/rehearsals/4412345678
Ari (Marketing): Run-of-show sketch (please refine):
```
00:00 — Intro & goals (Ari) 3m
03:00 — Eng playbook (Evan) 20m (demo at 10m)
23:00 — Bench summary (Maya) 6m
29:00 — Customer case (Liam) 8m
37:00 — Q&A moderated (Sam + panel) 5m
42:00 — CTA / checklist download / lead capture 3m
```
Sam (Content): Suggest we keep demo to a single reproducible flow: cold start -> warm cache -> quantized path. If live demo dies we play a 2m recorded clip.
Evan (Runtime): We'll script the demo as CLI + dashboard. Example snippet to run locally for rehearsal: 
```
# start demo server
python demo_server.py --model mpt-7b-quant --cache prefix
# run sample client
python demo_client.py --prompt "Summarize recent commit" --tokens 128
```
Maya (Benchmarks): For slides I'll include a one-slide digest for repo and one downloadable appendix with all numbers. Good to gate appendix for leads.
Jules (Growth): Landing page copy quick sketch: "MicroLabs: ship inference features faster — practical levers that cut cost without sacrificing latency. Register to get the checklist + benchmark pack." We'll wire GA and UTM.
Priya (Product): Can we add one interactive poll during webinar: "Which is your top pain: cost / latency / reliability / infra ops". That will enrich routing.
Jules (Growth): Yes — map poll answers to tags in HubSpot. Also please ensure form captures use-case free text so SDRs have context.
Ari (Marketing): Need speaker bios and headshots by Tue EOD. Liam, thanks for agreeing to join — can you send 2 quick bullets about HotelNow's win?
Liam (Customer - HotelNow): Happy to. 1) cut inference cost 3x after caching/quantization 2) latency improved from 1.2s -> 220ms for booking flow. I'll send bullets + logo.
Diego (Ops): Backup plan checklist for day-of if demo fails:
 - switch to recorded demo (Evan)
 - mute panelist mics and use single host channel (Diego)
 - fallback slide with data and take live questions only
Ari (Marketing): Roles recap: Host — Sam; Moderator — Ari; Presenters — Evan, Maya, Liam; Ops — Diego; Growth — Jules; Producer — Priya.
Sam (Content): I'll draft host script and share for comments by Tue 5pm.
greenroom-bot: Reminder set: rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT. Green room link: https://meet.redwood.ai/greenroom/4412345678
Jules (Growth): RSVP targets: 600 regs, 200 live, 120 content downloads. Will run targeted LinkedIn ads + newsletter.
Ari (Marketing): Perfect. Last asks: everyone react with :eyes: to confirm tasks and blockers by EOD. If no blockers, consider us on track. :raised_hands:
Evan (Runtime): :eyes: demo infra will need a small quota increase — filing ticket to infra now.
Maya (Benchmarks): :eyes: will need final numbers from infra by Monday.
Sam (Content): :eyes: drafting abstracts now.
Diego (Ops): :rotating_light: ops will book a backup VM for demos.
Ari (Marketing): Thanks team — I'll consolidate into a one-pager and post updated schedule here tomorrow.
Jules (Growth): Great — will sync on routing flows after abstracts land.
greenroom-bot: Event draft created in GA and HubSpot. Track ID: MID-4412345678
Ari (Marketing): Closing thread — small and focused. We'll iterate copy once the abstracts land. :white_check_mark:
